pythonFunction.name: update_autopay
pythonFunction.description:
Enrolls, updates or cancels AutoPay using a payment method already on file. A new card or bank
account cannot be added in this call. Needs an authenticated caller. Before calling this tool,
speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the authenticated account (REQUIRED).
    action: enrol, update or cancel (REQUIRED).
    payment_method: card or bank, or the last 4 digits of a method on file; not needed for
        cancel.
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, action, confirmation_number and, unless cancelled, method_type and
    method_last4.
